_readme: SAMPLE CONTENT — Phase 3 dummy catalogue for The House of Aayam. All names, prices, weights and images are illustrative placeholders for the draft catalogue build (Phase 4+). Nothing here is confirmed inventory, pricing or imagery. See 'Business Context/Phase 3 Dummy Catalogue and Content Contract.md' for the schema, display rules and pricing methodology.
